title: Thank You Jame!
text: Jame was very friendly and efficient. He was always on time and gave us good directions, although they weren't necessarily easy to follow but that was on us and the logistics of Monserrat. There were a few issues with our pre-tour communications but put it down to translational misunderstandings and everything worked out well in the end.
author: Brian_P

title: Awesome tour with James!
text:
Awesome tour with James! Our personal tour of Monserrat with James was phenomenal! 

He was so easy to work with and graciously accommodated our requests with stops at El Bruc and Santa Cecilia de Montserrat; a visit to the Throne Room of Our Lady of Montserrat; attending a concert by the Escolania de Montserrat Boys’ Choir; and hiking the paved path from the Saint Joan Funicular! 

Eternal memories! Thank you :)
author: Edward_H

title: Wonderful Day Trip to Monserrat
text: Our group of six hired James for a half day tour of the Monserrat Monastery near Barcelona.  The Monastery and Black Madonna were amazing and James provided excellent background information at each of our stops.  The scenery alone is worth the trip!
author: 90Kendall

title: Monserrat is a must visit
text: Our family had a great time with James on this tour.  He was a fantastic guide and driver.  He is a local and shared a lot of fun information about the area in addition to Monserrat.  Monserrat is a must visit with the black Madonna if you have time during your Spain vacation.  James procured our tickets for the viewing in advance of our excursion with him saving us time and ensuring we did not miss this beautiful experience.  Thanks James!
author: 552geetam

title: Montserrat with Jaime
text: We really enjoyed our time with Jaime and the trip up to Montserrat. He provided information as we drove through Barcelona up to Montserrat — current and historic information about the city and its people.  (It was January so quite cold, and he even gave one of our girls his coat to use…he went above and beyond!). The area was beautiful and I understand why so many locals escape for the day to hike and enjoy the views.  If you are going to Montserrat, I would highly suggest Jaime, and especially if you are in a group!
author: angelawQ2103UG

title: Highly recommended
text: My family and I had a great time in Barcelona. Jaime went above and beyond. He was very accommodating. It was easy to coordinate with him.
author: Marian_M

title: Montserrat
text: Lovely trip to Montserrat. Easy pick up from the airport, transfer to Montserrat and transfer to our cruise ship. Great way to spend our first day!
author: jshulerderamo

title: Wonderful visit to Monserrat, highly recommend!
text: We had a wonderful visit to Monserrat! James was on time, easy to communicate with before the tour, and very knowledgeable. He helped us plan our time there well and we felt like we got much more out of the experience than if we had just visited on our own. Highly recommend!
author: littlechickn

title: A worthwhile day trip!
text: James was great! We had a wonderful half-day tour to Monserrat. The car was spacious and comfortable; James had great tips for what we should do in Monserrat and even went ahead and secured us tickets to see the Black Madonna while we were there. I would highly recommend this as a day trip from Barcelona!
